hook: *10* Deodorants Tested, Zero Make Your Shirt Chalky
dek: Men's Health editors ranked the best deodorants for 2026, no antiperspirants allowed.

slides.label: What Happened
slides.text: Men's Health grooming editors tested and ranked the *10 best deodorants* for men heading into 2026.

slides.label: The Catch
slides.text: Every pick is a *deodorant, not an antiperspirant*. Antiperspirants use aluminum to block sweat glands; deodorants just fight the smell.

slides.label: Best Overall
slides.text: *Oars & Alps Aluminum-Free Deodorant* wins top spot: vegan, no parabens or sulfates, and it leaves zero residue on clothes.

slides.label: Best Spray
slides.text: *Mando Whole Body Deodorant* applies invisibly and claims up to *72-hour* protection anywhere on the body.

slides.label: Best Unscented
slides.text: *Bravo Sierra Deodorant* was field-tested by over *1,000 U.S. Special Forces* soldiers and goes on completely clear.

slides.label: Best Whole Body
slides.text: *Native Cucumber Mint Deodorant* is aluminum- and paraben-free, made for pits, legs, and everywhere in between.

slides.label: Best Drugstore
slides.text: *Old Spice Swagger Deodorant* is the cheapest stick on the list and still delivers an all-day sandalwood scent.

slides.label: Why It Matters
slides.text: Good grooming shouldn't require a big budget. Knowing which *affordable options actually work* matters for anyone watching every dollar.

caption_instagram:
10 deodorants, zero antiperspirants: Men's Health grooming editors just dropped their 2026 rankings of the best deodorants for men.

The list skips antiperspirants entirely since those rely on aluminum to physically block sweat glands. Instead, testers ranked deodorants that fight odor and bacteria without stopping sweat, from Oars & Alps (best overall) to Mando's 72-hour spray, Bravo Sierra's Special Forces-tested formula, Native's whole-body stick, and Old Spice Swagger as the budget drugstore pick.

Good grooming doesn't have to mean a premium price tag. Knowing which cheap option actually holds up all day matters when every dollar counts, especially for anyone building a routine on a budget.

Stick, spray, or balm? Pick one.
